verdict.rationale: Next.js's own docs say it streams UI from the server through the App Router and React Suspense. They also describe async server components that await data and add no client JavaScript. A community report independently confirms SSR works out of the box. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of streaming behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming specifically, and evidence that streaming measurably improves time-to-interactive.

support.subject: As a developer, I can render my application on the server with streaming support to reach interactivity faster

citations.quote: Instantly stream UI from the server, integrated with the App Router and React Suspense.
Make your React component async and await your data.
Add components without sending additional client-side JavaScript.
SSR plus SPA rendering out of the box
